That was fine with me because we and earlier generations fought to secure the right to free speech. But they yelled every expletive you can think of, threw bottles at us, and called us baby killers. Welcome Home!!!

I didn't mind, they had a right to their opinion, but the bottles and cans did not.

But on my first night home, I wanted nothing more than to enjoy a steak and a cold beer at the Top of the Mark restaurant which was one of my parents favorites. On my way there from my hotel, I encountered an angry group of anti-war protesters (hint--we were required to wear our uniforms on liberty in those days). I don't remember how many they were but my guess is between 5 and 8.

They were taunting me (baby killer and all) and I could see that this wasn't going to end peacefully.

Not surprisingly, I didn't get to the Top of the Mark but instead ended up in a Naval Clinic getting some stitches. I won't lie. I got the crap beat out of me, but I decided that I wasn't going to back down.

That's a homecoming I will never forget. Why are leftist so violent and intolerant?
